description: This is a Python script for generating JSON configuration files based on input parameters, command-line arguments, and module loading. It includes functions for module loading, file manipulation, and configuration parameter extraction, and contains a main routine that processes command-line inputs to produce a JSON output.

methods.name: file_name
methods.description: Extracts the base filename without extension from a given path.

methods.name: load_module
methods.description: Loads a Python module from a specified file path using importlib machinery.

methods.name: prepend_file
methods.description: Prepends a line to the beginning of a specified file.

methods.name: get_config_params
methods.description: Reads configuration parameters from a file into a list of lines.

methods.name: check_assignment
methods.description: Checks if a variable is assigned or copied within a file by searching for its presence inside parentheses.
